 state[t1].add(state['R'].pop())
 # step2 K B->R only if K B
 if 'K' not in state['B']: continue
 state['R'].add('K');state['B'].remove('K')
 for a,b in combinations(C,2):

  src4=next(c for c,v in s.items() if 'M' in v)
  for t4 in C:

   q={c:set(v) for c,v in s.items()};q[src4].remove('M');q[t4].add('M')

   q[ss].remove('S');q[sk].remove('K');q[ss].add('K');q[sk].add('S')
   src6=next(c for c,v in q.items() if 'M'in v)
   for t6 in C:
